generic_local_profile.note: First-time squadron package removed; Git history keeps the blank profile.

migrations.summary: Baseline registration of persistent installed state. No migration is required for v0.4.1.

Pantons local guidance adds the approved Monday-through-Thursday battle rhythm and model-role separation. Existing Pantons installs must review and merge these workflow changes rather than overwrite their human-maintained Local Profile.
instructions: Review the supplied Pantons Local Profile - REFERENCE ONLY.docx against the squadron's current Local Guidance/Local Profile.docx.

Merge the approved weekly battle rhythm and model-role section: Monday inputs due, Tuesday ingest/planning, Wednesday build, Thursday full Gemini QC, optional separate DO Terra/Grok review, then sell/post-sell/execution reflows.
Preserve all locally approved scheduling rules and later human edits. Do not replace the entire current Local Profile automatically.
Have the appropriate human authority confirm the merged Local Profile before using the new System package for a new scheduling week.

migrations.summary: Workflow authority is corrected so the Thursday schedule buy/sell is the formal DO buy event, post-buy/sell work implements and QC's the recorded directions without a routine second buy, and publication remains a separate human action. The operator manual is also organized by day/step.
instructions: Review the supplied reference-only Local Profile copy against the squadron's current Local Guidance/Local Profile.docx.

Merge the workflow-authority change: Thursday buy/sell is the formal DO buy when explicitly approved; the presented schedule plus recorded DO directions is the approved baseline; faithful implementation does not require a routine second buy; material deviations return to the DO; publication is separate.

For Pantons, also align the weekly battle-rhythm wording to the day-based manual: Monday inputs, Tuesday start and planning, Wednesday build, Thursday QC/optional adversarial review/buy-sell, Friday publication, then execution reflows.
Preserve all squadron-specific scheduling rules, later human edits, approvals and local references. Do not replace the entire current Local Profile automatically.
Have the appropriate human authority confirm the merged Local Profile before using package 0.5.2 for a new scheduling week.

migrations.summary: Review the current local workflow guidance once. This consolidates prior battle-rhythm/Buy-Sell migrations and replaces named-model preferences with model-neutral conversations and no subagent delegation.
instructions: Compare the supplied reference-only Local Profile with your current Local Guidance/Local Profile.docx. Never replace human-maintained local guidance automatically.
Preserve approved numerical scheduling rules and later local edits. For other squadrons, use their actual approved rules; the blank profile supplies no Pantons defaults.

Use the normal weekly flow: Monday inputs, Tuesday intake/planning, Wednesday build/integration, Thursday full QC and optional independent DO review, Thursday Buy/Sell, directed changes/final QC, Friday publication, then execution reflows.
Remove named-model workflow prerequisites. Keep one main conversation per execution week; optional DO review uses a separate human-started conversation. Do not delegate to subagents.

Keep Thursday Buy/Sell as the formal DO buy only when explicitly approved. The exact presented schedule plus recorded directions is the approved baseline; faithful implementation needs no routine second buy; material departures return to the DO; publication is separate.
Have the appropriate human authority confirm the merged local guidance before using the new System for next week.

migrations.summary: Add the required and optional input checklist to the reusable weekly folder without replacing existing local guidance or operational work.
instructions: Review Weekly Inputs Checklist - REFERENCE ONLY.docx in Persistent Migration Sources. It lists input products; it creates no scheduling rule or approval.
Copy that document into COPY THIS FOLDER FOR EACH NEW WEEK/Inputs and name the copy INPUT CHECKLIST.docx. Keep any existing collection notes and source files.
New weekly folder copies will include the checklist. Existing weekly sources, schedules and decisions stay in place.

Replace the entire System folder and START HERE using the normal update instructions. One-time setup materials are outside System and are supplied only in the first-time squadron package. Do not restart guidance setup or replace Local Guidance.

migrations.summary: Package 0.7.0 replaces the System folder with TASK FILES and combines the Local Profile, Stable References and Playbook into one Squadron Rules file. The weekly folder now holds Inputs, Schedules and the saved WEEK FILEs (no Working Record folder). Squadron Rules carries the new-chat-per-task wording the DO approved on 2026-10-12. This is a one-time move from 0.6.x; an update cannot convert the old layout.
instructions: Coming from 0.6.x: do not extract an update over your old folder. Download Panton_Scheduling_Assistant.zip, extract it, and put the new Panton Scheduling Assistant folder next to your old one.

If your squadron edited its old Local Guidance (Local Profile, Stable References or Playbook), copy those edits into the matching section of the new Squadron Rules.docx, then have the DO confirm the merged file. Never replace human-maintained rules automatically.
The new Squadron Rules already includes the DO-approved new-chat-per-task wording. If you merge by hand instead, use the reference copy at the end of this file.
Finish an active week with the kit you started it on. Start the next week with the new kit; keep old week folders as records.
Already on package 0.7.0 or later: nothing to do for this item.
